The state’s major unions, and progressive politicians such as Bernie Sanders, the Vermont senator, and Ro Khanna, a California congressman, backed Prop 40. But both the Democratic and Republican candidates for governor, as well as organizations such as Planned Parenthood Affiliates of California, a lobbying branch of the healthcare group, opposed it – pointing to its structure as a one-off tax that would only fund certain healthcare programs. Prop 40’s most vocal critics, however, were the state’s billionaires. Donors to the opposition campaign were a who’s who of Silicon Valley , including executives from Google, Palantir, DoorDash, Stripe and Reddit, along with several prominent venture capitalists. "The law needs to get ahead of and, in some cases, make sure that it catches up with, what is a very fast changing world," Albanese said. Tom Brady ends tenure as investor in Birmingham City after three years
clusters.text: NFL legend Tom Brady has ended his association with top-of-the-table Championship side Birmingham City. The record seven-time Super Bowl champion became a minority owner in the St Andrew's club in August 2023 when he "entered a partnership" with club owners Knighthead Capital Management LLC. Part of Brady's role involved him being chairman of an advisory board at Birmingham, with the club saying he would be "both investing [as well as] committing his time and extensive expertise" following his arrival. However, the Blues announced his exit , external with a statement headlined 'Tom Brady departure'. They added: "Birmingham City Football Club expresses its sincere gratitude to Tom Brady for his involvement with and unwavering support for the club over the last three years. "It was truly amazing to have someone with Tom's experience and passion associated with the club, and the club looks forward to continuing to build on that foundation from the training ground to the Birmingham community." Former quarterback Brady, a three-time NFL most valuable player, retired in February 2023 after 23 seasons in the NFL, having won six Super Bowl rings with the New England Patriots and one with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers. Following the end of his playing career, he acquired a stake in the Las Vegas Raiders while also becoming part of the ownership group of the WNBA's Las Vegas Aces. On top of that, Brady's commitments include him being a lead NFL analyst for Fox Sports. He leaves with Birmingham top of the Championship on goal difference with 29 points after 15 games.

clusters.text: Salesforce, Inc. said on the 10th it plans to expand where its AI workplace collaboration solution Agentforce Coworker can be used, bringing it to major work environments such as Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365, and Google Workspace, as well as to dedicated mobile and desktop apps. Agentforce Coworker breaks a user's request into multiple steps and connects each task with the right AI agent and workflow to carry it out. It delivers the outcome and next actions to the user and supports review and approval. According to Salesforce, Inc., Coworker can be activated from the settings menu without a separate, complex setup process. It uses not only existing Salesforce, Inc. data such as customer management and service histories, but also external data supported through Data 360. It is designed to comply with company-defined data access permissions and sharing rules. Salesforce, Inc. plans to officially launch integration with MS Teams and dedicated apps for iOS, Mac, and Windows this month, following its Google Workspace and MS 365 integrations. It will also roll out a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server this month that can connect to external AI services. In December, it plans to introduce Scheduled Jobs, which automatically handle repetitive tasks, and Daily Digest, which compiles and delivers key daily priorities. Salesforce, Inc. also unveiled new pricing for Agentforce Coworker. To help companies predict AI adoption costs, it added a flat rate of $50 per user per month based on global pricing. Park Se-jin, CEO of Salesforce, Inc. Korea, said, "For companies to fully apply AI to work, usage by front-line teams and trust in the data must go hand in hand, and Agentforce Coworker strikes the right balance between the two, which we expect will raise the level of AI transformation at Korean companies by a notch," adding, "Salesforce, Inc. will keep strengthening its support so Korean companies can innovate how they work and their culture on the basis of AI and create new business value."
